text: Absolutely, the museum should stage the interactive sound exhibit! Evidence A highlights that the design enforces hearing-safe volume limits, ensuring visitors can fully engage with the exhibits without risking hearing damage. Additionally, evidence B emphasizes that a visitor-composed soundscape gallery would be a national first, offering unparalleled creativity and community involvement from visitors themselves. Lastly, evidence C provides assurance through a confirmed sponsor covering both installation and the inaugural season, guaranteeing this unique experience will be well-supported financially. These factors combine to create a compelling case for integrating such an innovative and engaging exhibition at our institution.
